summary.text:
Tech weakness pressured US equities, with Nvidia falling 5.47% and the Nasdaq 100 dropping 0.6%, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.38%. European markets were firmer, with the Euro Stoxx 50 rising 0.59%, despite discussions over European tech reliance on the US and Bessent noting the US and China should harbor no illusions competing on AI.

The US dollar index held at 102.251 as the euro fell 0.52% to 1.1164 and the dollar gained 0.5% against the yen to 158.779. In commodities, gold rose 0.99% to 4069.8999, Brent crude gained 0.81% to 92.23, and WTI rose 0.38% to 86.37, while bitcoin dropped 1.96% to 73750.1719.

Attention turns to AI developments amid reports Anthropic bankers are preparing an IPO valuation of 1.5 trillion dollars. Traders also watch insider sales at Snowflake and Hilton, alongside French proposals to reduce the maximum compensation duration for non-exempt long-term illnesses.
